description.en: The lights are down, the stage is gone, but the music stays. It sits on your phone—a grand instrument that forgot how to shout, now playing a silent nocturne in the palm of your hand. It’s the quietest classic you’ll ever own, a pocket-sized intermission in the grand performance.
